part.text:
Fixed abstract Unix socket handling in:

- `tokio/src/net/unix/listener.rs`
- `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs`

Both APIs now remove the leading NUL marker before passing the abstract name to `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, preventing the duplicate NUL and incorrect sockaddr length.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-tokio-rs__tokio-6838-343fda47 sh -lc \
  'cd /testbed && /usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo test -p tokio --test uds_stream --features full abstract_socket_name'
```

Result: `abstract_socket_name ... ok`. `git diff --check` also passes.
